title: Manager, Business Development & Project Management (Power Infrastructure)
description:
Company Description:


Hunt Energy Network (HEN), founded in 2018, specializes in delivering world‑class clean energy solutions. The company provides comprehensive support across the project lifecycle, from securing land leases and developing energy infrastructure to navigating the complex regulatory landscape of the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) power market. HEN develops and deploys advanced energy storage assets that supply ERCOT with a distributed, coordinated fleet of fast‑responding resources to help efficiently balance the grid. Its proprietary TraDER platform automates trading and settlement activities across the portfolio while optimizing project siting and asset performance. With nearly one in six BESS assets in ERCOT, Hunt Energy Network is among the market’s leading operators.


Position Summary:


Hunt Energy Network is developing large\-scale islanded (behind\-the\-meter) power campuses serving hyperscale AI data center loads, anchored by a multi\-hundred\-MW natural gas engine and BESS program currently in active development. This hybrid role pairs commercial origination with hands\-on project execution: the Manager will advance offtake and partnership opportunities for the islanded power platform while managing day\-to\-day development execution — vendors, permits, schedule, and budget — under the Vice President of EPC. The role also supports evaluation and execution of broader business development and M\&A opportunities across the Hunt energy platform.


Responsibilities:


**Business Development Responsibilities**

* Originate, qualify, and advance offtake counterparties (hyperscalers, data center developers, large industrial loads) for the islanded power package; manage teaser/CIM processes, NDAs, data rooms, and diligence responses.
* Structure and negotiate commercial frameworks — PPAs and power\-as\-a\-service offerings, build\-own\-transfer, JV, and asset sale structures — in coordination with legal, finance, and executive lead
